notes.title: Gamepad support added!
notes.content:
We've added gamepad support!

Now, if you have no extra USB mouse, you can play the game simulating a mouse with a standard gamepad and still enjoy the game with your friends.

This also enables new ways to play the game, like sitting on the couch and watching it in a big TV.

notes.title: Offline bots support added!
notes.content:
We've added offline bots support, so now you can enjoy the full game no matter how far you live from the official servers.

That also enables you to play some really fun local multiplayer matches with your friends, playing all against a whole team of bots, or however you like!
